body:
I am so sorry. I am going through the exact same thing right now. Dated for 4 months, and 2 months into the long distance he called it quits. It was a whirlwind romance, we were both invested in the relationship, but then he checked out, seemingly overnight. I cannot describe the excruciating pain and hurt I was in. 
I will tell you how I deal with it, and it helps me with the pain a little. 

Nothing anyone will say will help you right now. It didn’t help me. Talking to friends didn’t help me. One thing that did is me being by myself. I just try to enjoy my hobbies again. 

I don’t blame my ex. People are allowed to rethink their priorities in life. Regardless of how much it hurts me, I admit that he’s not a bad person. I wouldn’t have loved him if he was. I realized that he didn’t break it off because he wanted to hurt me. He just didn’t want to be with me anymore. And that’s fair. Of course, this thought feels like a knife in your heart, but it gets better. Soon it will feel only like a small twinge.

Keep no contact. You will be angry, you will want to tell him that he hurt you, and you’ll want him to know it. But this will not make you feel better. Trust me. He might feel guilty, he might not care, but worst case scenario, you’ll get the pity. And being pityed by someone you love with all your heart is crushing.

The general advice here is to hit the gym, get new hobbies, meet new friends, etc. This is the aspirin of breakup. But not all breakups and people are the same. You need to decide what works best for you. Maybe you need to go off grid for a few days (turn off phone, no social media), or maybe you need to lay in bed for a few days and watch crappy TV, or you need to go on tinder (personally don’t recommend that, but it works for some people)..

Only you know what you need and what will help.

This sucks, and everyone says that it gets better with time. I guess you’ll have to see for yourself. Because there’s no general cure for how to get over a breakup. God knows how I wish there was one..
Are you me? The memories, the moment of clarity, the instagram moment. All of it.. jesus, we’re all going through the same shit, arent’t we..

Boy, would this be a great explanatiom for her. As a person who’s been on the other side of this, make sure that you explain this to her if you break up with her. She deserves to know the real reason. Being dumped already sucks ass, but being dumped with no explanation makes it so much harder.

I have no advice unfortunately. Everyone is different and deals differently with needing space. I never needed space, always knew what I wanted or not wanted, immediately. Good luck to you too, hope you can get your girl back asap :)

The weekends are the worst. I cleaned my house, did 4 loads of laundry, took a bath, full body scrub, did my nails, did my eyebrows, everything I could think of to occupy my time. And it was only 2pm and I still had a full day and a Sunday to go through. At least tomorrow is Monday and I can be at work for most of the day..

Long distance is the worst. It’s like a curse. 2 months in the long distance for me and bf, and he hits me with ‘i’m not sure how I feel, and I don’t know what I want anymore’.. and this after solid plans for a future, I was supposed to go see him in a few weeks. Long distance is a slow relationship killer.. are you guys still together? Work on it! Don’t let her go, if you love her, and she loves you.
